newsitem.title: UK: Ladbroke gains after 34 pct rise in profit.
newsitem.headline: Ladbroke gains after 34 pct rise in profit.

text.p: Shares in betting and hotel company Ladbroke Group Plc were indicated higher in pre-market trade on Thursday after the group posted profits of 163 million stg.
The shares were 6-1/2p higher at 231-1/2p by 0810 GMT.
Analysts had been expecting profits of between 155-165 million stg and a total dividend of 6.2p met with best expectations.
"The results were a little better than our expectations at both the pretax and the earnings per share level," said Nigel Reed, industry analyst at Paribas Capital Markets.
Earnings per share before exceptional items were up 40 percent to 10.44 pence during the period.
Reed said his forecasts had been towards the bottom end of the range of expectations.
Profits for the betting and gaming division jumped 46 percent to 84.9 million stg whilst the hotels group saw profits of 160.2 million stg, compared with 150.2 million stg a year ago.
"Betting was much better than we thought and hotels were slightly under what we thought they could do," Reed said.
The company said that it expected to make further progress in 1997.
